name: Son of Mars

book: Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Ares

facets.bk: Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Ares

body:
Son of Mars
CR 10

XP 9,600
Human fighter 3, champion of martial fury 5, war spawn 3
CE, NE, or LE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +2; Senses Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 breastplate, +2 heavy, wooden shield, +1 Shield Focus, +2 enhancement magic vestment)
hp +96 (10d10+30)
Fort +12, Ref +8, Will +10 (+11 vs. fear)
Immunities Charm spells and spell-like abilities, disease, fear

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee shortsword +14/+9 (1d6+3/19-20×2), spear +16/+11 (1d8+5/20×3), lance +16/+11 (1d8+5/20×3)
Ranged javelin +15/+10 (1d6+5)
Spell-like Abilities (CL 11; Charisma-based)

1/day—divine power, magic weapon, magic vestment, spiritual weapon

Martial Fury Spells Prepared (CL 5th; concentration +11)

2nd—bull’s strength
1st—cure light wounds

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 12
Base Atk +11; CMB +14; CMD 26
Feats Dodge, Great Fortitude, Mobility, Mounted Combat, Shield Focus, Spring Attack, Toughness, Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike
Skills Climb +7, Handle Animal +6, Heal +6, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (religion) +7, Knowledge (war) +8, Perception +7, Profession (soldier) +8, Ride +6, Sense Motive +7, Spellcraft +7, Survival +5, Swim +7
Languages Latin, Oscan, plus Greek or Punic

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Armor Training (Ex), Aura of Courage (Su), Bolster Chaos (Su), Bravery (Ex), Chosen Enemy (Su) 2/day, Divine Bond (Sp) Bonded Mount- heavy horse, Divine Health (Ex), Martial Magic (Sp) (war domain), Martial Training (Ex) (spears), Regimented Training (Ex), Unyielding Assault (Su), War Cry (Su), Wrathful Strike (Ex)

TACTICS

Before Combat At the start of the day, a son of mars casts magic vestment. Before combat, a son of mars will cast whichever spell they have available to further increase their martial success.

During Combat A son of mars will engage any spellcasters to make spellcasting as difficult for them as possible. They’ll also target the most threatening adversary first while ignoring lesser threats.

Gear shortsword, spear, lance, heavy horse, component pouch, waterskin, 33 gp

ECOLOGY

Environment any, mountains Southern Italy
Organization solitary, patrol (2), or squad (6-10)
Treasure weapons and armor and heavy horse
